§a【Welcome】123Technology Machine Guide§r
Welcome to the 123Technology mod!

This quest line introduces all the multiblock machines, organized by recipe tier (when you can craft each machine):
  Tier 0.5 -- Steam Age
  Tier 1   -- LV  Low Voltage        (32 EU/t)
  Tier 2   -- MV  Medium Voltage     (128 EU/t)
  Tier 3   -- HV  High Voltage       (512 EU/t)
  Tier 4   -- EV  Extreme Voltage    (2048 EU/t)
  Tier 5   -- IV  Insulated Voltage  (8192 EU/t)
  Tier 6   -- LuV Low Ultra Voltage  (32768 EU/t)
  Tier 7   -- ZPM Zero Point Module  (131072 EU/t)
  Tier 8   -- UV  Ultimate Voltage   (524288 EU/t)
  Tier 9   -- UHV Ultra High Voltage (2097152 EU/t)
  Tier 10  -- UEV Ultra Excessive Voltage (8388608 EU/t)
  Tier 11  -- UIV Ultra Immense Voltage II  (33554432 EU/t)
  Tier 12  -- UMV Ultra Mega Voltage III (134217728 EU/t)
  Tier 13  -- UXV Ultra eXtreme Voltage IV  (536870912 EU/t)

Quest requirement: just tick the checkbox, no need to hold any items.
Have fun playing! BB~
